sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.4.4 — Fail-safe transient injection & OPcache locks bypass

  • OPcache Locks Bypass: Programmatically flush memory file locks during execution immediately before the extraction process, eliminating permission errors during file directory swap.
  • Fail-safe transient injection: Implemented manual force transient updates injection prior to running WordPress programmatic updates, ensuring WordPress reliably finds and executes plugin package upgrades.
  • Global Scope Class Declarations: Relocated `Cora_Upgrade_Skin` to a dedicated file at the global scope, resolving PHP class nesting compilation errors.
  • Real-Time Upgrade Progress Bar: Custom percentage indicator showing the download, verify, backup, and extraction status in real-time.
  • Custom Dialogue UI Integration: High-fidelity confirm modals replacing the browser-native dialog popup.
